translations.web: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers, to receive his fruit.
translations.bsb: When the harvest time drew near, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his share of the fruit.
translations.kjv: And when the time of the fruit drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, that they might receive the fruits of it.
translations.asv: And when the season of the fruits drew near, he sent his servants to the husbandmen, to receive his fruits.
